lines.text: Jehoahaz becomes king at twenty-three, reigns three months in Jerusalem, and does evil in the sight of the LORD.
Pharaoh Neco imprisons Jehoahaz at Damascus so he cannot reign, and puts a levy on Judah.
Neco makes Eliakim king and renames him Jehoiakim, who taxes the people to pay the silver and gold.
Nebuchadnezzar invades, Jehoiakim serves him for seven years then rebels, and the LORD sends raiders against Judah.
Jehoiakim rests with his fathers and his son Jehoiachin reigns, while Babylon takes all the territory of Egypt's king.
